preconditions.description: The number of opening brackets n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The total nesting k must be between 0 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' if k > n * (n - 1) // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If k exceeds the maximum possible nesting sum, output 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == 2 * n and all(c in '()' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a regular bracket sequence of length 2n consisting only of '(' and ')'.
The total sum of nesting of all opening brackets in the output must equal k.
